title: Zero-Shot Weight-Space Programming for Prediction and Classification of Target Variables in Structured Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2611.19292v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weight-space programming fixes every parameter of a feed-forward network by hand, with no gradient descent anywhere in the construction. Every demonstration so far starts from a target function handed to the model as a rule system, making it a compilation problem. A supervised dataset withholds that specification, so the procedure must do the statistical inference itself and then express the result in the parameterisation it was given. We ask whether a large language model can do both. It is shown a small dataset in full, with the architecture of a feed-forward network, and writes out every weight and bias as a literal number, with no optimizer, no gradient, no code execution, and no chance to evaluate it first. Each construction is sealed and pre-registers its expected score. translated_title: 離题：面向结构化数据集目标变量预测与分类的零样本权重空间编程
translated_abstract: 权重空间编程是指以手工方式固定前馈网络的每一个参数，整个构建过程中不使用任何梯度下降。迄今为止的所有演示都是从以规则系统形式提供给模型的目标函数出发，这使其成为一个编译问题。而监督数据集并不提供这种规范说明，因此该过程必须自行完成统计推断，然后将结果用给定的参数化形式表达出来。我们探究大语言模型能否同时做到这两点。实验中向模型完整展示一个小数据集，并给出前馈网络的架构，由其将每一个权重和偏置都写成字面数字——全程不使用优化器、不使用梯度、不执行代码，也没有机会先进行评估。每个构建结果都被封存并预先登记其预期得分。评分测试套件从两个玩具问题开始，经过九个由隐藏旋转加以伪装的合成问题，直至经典基准测试以及一个真实工程问……
tldr: 该论文证明大语言模型可以在零样本条件下，仅凭展示的小数据集与指定网络架构，无需优化器、梯度或代码执行，就手写出前馈网络的全部权重和偏置，在从玩具问题、合成问题到经典基准和真实工程任务的测试中直接完成结构化数据的目标变量预测与分类。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that a large language model can, in a zero-shot manner and given only a small dataset and an architecture, hand-write every weight and bias of a feed-forward network—no optimizer, gradients, or code execution—achieving prediction and classification of target variables in structured datasets across toy, synthetic, classical benchmark, and real engineering tasks.
